items.title: [VIA] Recruitment for Volunteers (Project Noeul)
items.author: Lee Su Ling, Clara
items.description:
Nothing to do next weekend? HELLO, we are Project Noeul, a group of students working with Ren Ci Community Hospital to spread love and joy to the elderly! We will be holding a total of 1 befriending session in the month of October and will need around
10 volunteers
for the session. More details will be sent out via WhatsApp.
The session will include
karaoke, food memory game and bingo
!
CIP hours 🕰️: 2.5 hours
Date & Time
: 31 October 2026, 9am - 1130am (Saturday)
Venue
: Ren Ci @ Ang Mo Kio (Nursing Home) 10 Ang Mo Kio Ave 8, Singapore 567727
Extra information to note:
Mask-wearing is required for all volunteers when engaging seniors at the centre
Dress code: Half school uniform/ any tshirt with long pants & covered shoes, NO slippers, singlets or shorts
Interested? Sign up here:
https://forms.gle/uasEjYr7WuizD4X89
Thank you for your time! Follow our Instagram @project.noeul for more! Thank you and we look forward to serving the elderly with YOU!
